purpose: Deterministic native, legacy, malformed and unsupported-open fixtures for G9A3 lifecycle and migration hardening.

boundary.geoCeDGProfile: AppConfigGeoCeDG using the fork shared kernel
boundary.geoCeDGClassicDiagnostic: AppConfigDefault using the same fork shared kernel in a separate process
boundary.externalUpstream: An external upstream GeoGebra distribution outside the native GeoCeDG persistence guarantee

provenancePolicy: All newly added XML fixtures are project-authored test inputs.
The external-upstream loss-shape fixture is synthetic and is not represented as output captured from an external runtime.
The existing G9A2 GGB remains the canonical native spatial model and is referenced rather than duplicated or resaved.
Corrupt and future-version documents are test-private and are not Java-kernel model fixtures or user documents.

entries.testMechanism: real GeoCeDG and fork-Classic load/recompute/save/reopen without modifying source bytes
entries.expected: Exact typed identities, relations, revisions, certificates and normalized spatial XML are preserved.

entries.testMechanism: real host two-stage load and deterministic rewrite
entries.expected: Record order has no authority and the POINT certificate is current after resolution.

entries.testMechanism: real host two-stage load, runtime withdrawal and deterministic rewrite
entries.expected: The v2 POINT object remains explicitly BROKEN on its exact missing binding ID, publishes no payload and is never repaired by appearance.
Ordinary geometry remains valid and unassociated.

entries.testMechanism: real host load with label, layer, coordinate and order permutations
entries.expected: Zero spatial associations exist until a complete explicit typed request is applied.
Version-one records do not imply version-two POINT semantics.
The exact missing ID is diagnosed and ordinary coincident geometry is not used as repair authority.
The native graph rejects atomically and the duplicate is never remapped.

entries.testMechanism: strict record parsing and prospective-graph validation
entries.expected: Unknown role and inadmissible map family fail before publication.
The future section fails atomically and truthfully with no downgrade.
The future record fails truthfully with no partial publication.

entries.testMechanism: real GeoCeDG host load plus static external-boundary classification
entries.expected: Ordinary geometry loads normally and has no spatial association.

entries.testMechanism: real GeoCeDG host load plus migration hard-zero assertions
entries.expected: The geometry is legacy/unassociated; no label, list or coordinate downgrade or repair is invoked.

openQuestions: A real external-upstream runtime observation may be added only if the exact external binary/version and saved artifacts are provenance-recorded.
Public migration interaction remains deferred to a separately authorized frontend phase.
